attributes.name: Vanilla Minecraft
attributes.description: Mojang vanilla server. Download server.jar via Files > Download from URL (or attach a modpack at creation).

variables.name: Server jar file
variables.description: The jar to run. Fetch it with Files > Download from URL.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Vanilla Minecraft install script. Server files: /mnt/server
apt-get update -qq; apt-get install -yqq curl jq ca-certificates
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -f "$SERVER_JARFILE" ]; then rm -f "$SERVER_JARFILE"; fi

MANIFEST=$(curl -s https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest.json)
if [ -z "$MC_VERSION" ] || [ "$MC_VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
    MC_VERSION=$(echo "$MANIFEST" | jq -r '.latest.release')
fi
echo "installing vanilla Minecraft ${MC_VERSION}"

VER_URL=$(echo "$MANIFEST" | jq -r ".versions[] | select(.id==\\"$MC_VERSION\\") | .url")
if [ -z "$VER_URL" ]; then
    echo "unknown Minecraft version: ${MC_VERSION}"
    exit 1
fi
JAR_URL=$(curl -s "$VER_URL" | jq -r '.downloads.server.url')
curl -sSLo "$SERVER_JARFILE" "$JAR_URL"

echo "download complete"
